reasons.overall: Atmospheric and playable enough to recover all memories, but portrait map failure and crowded information materially interrupt mobile play.
reasons.controls: Held fire, movement, USE, reload, jump and DASH responded. Precise touch aiming required substantial corrections; my low accuracy is a reviewer limitation as well as evidence of the challenge.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery rewards and phase-break feedback support progress. Patrol pressure remained dangerous while navigating, culminating in a legitimate loss. Boss combat was not meaningfully tested.
reasons.presentation: Strong title, lighting, rain and cohesive cyan/amber industrial setting. Tall plain surfaces dominate when close to cover.
reasons.usability: Map opened largely offscreen and its normal close control could not be reached with supplied transport. Recovery required a fresh session. Receiver distance prompts were useful.
reasons.readability: Main health, ammo and buttons readable. Small tracked text and contextual notices compete; service hints overlap health/controls and boss/cache notices overlap at three-memory transition.

attempts.actions: Read visible handbook; deployed; held FIRE to eliminate induction guard; reloaded; moved west; jumped low service grate; looked and navigated toward archive; opened MAP; attempted native swipe and CLOSE MAP.
attempts.blocker: Map rendered above and left of viewport, CLOSE MAP unreachable. Driver command error: Target outside viewport; scroll with native down/move/up gesture before tapping
attempts.recovery: Explicit close, waited for exit code 0, ps -p 73311,73325 returned no processes (exit 1). Relaunched normal URL at same portrait size in distinct prefix. Parent Pause-button recovery hint arrived after this driver had already closed and was not used.

attempts.actions: Killed induction guard with held FIRE; reload; flank via west triage; DASH canceled discharge; corrected position using outside-reach prompt and held USE to recover Mara. Navigated back through exit and across courtyard. Recovered Elian with DASH/USE, then Sera with DASH and movement/USE. Attempted to advance toward Custodian; patrol pressure killed suit before meaningful coil combat.
attempts.closure: Explicit close, waited for exit code 0, ps -p 77410,77420 returned no processes (exit 1).

coverage.reason: First run blocked in portrait planning UI; authorized transport recovery used. No third run.

actionableIssues.issue: Portrait map partly offscreen; close and header outside viewport
actionableIssues.action: Constrain and center map to portrait visual viewport; keep Close Map reachable and verify native touch scrolling.

actionableIssues.issue: Contextual service hints overlap health and controls
actionableIssues.action: Reserve a portrait prompt lane above touch controls; avoid health/ammo overlap.

actionableIssues.issue: Three-memory cache announcement, memory card and boss panel overlap
actionableIssues.action: Queue notices or allocate separate portrait slots.

limitations: Emulated mobile Chromium with software graphics; not physical phone or Safari certification.
Pause-assisted screenshots and discrete native touch actions; no performance, audio or human-feel certification.
Exactly two sessions; first blocked nonterminal and second actual loss. No third attempt.
Navigation and aim mistakes preserved; 5% accuracy should not be treated as a controlled balance measurement.
Only normal URL and visible UI text/geometry used; no source, hidden state, tests or other reviews read.
